function.name: get_expenses_by_month_markdown
function.description: Returns the pandas dataframe in markdown format for wanted timeframe. Returns only expenses, not incomes.

function.name: get_expenses_by_month_interval_markdown
function.description: Returns the pandas dataframe in markdown format for wanted time interval. Returns only expenses, not incomes.

first_month.description: wanted first month of the interval in %B format (e.g., 'March').

first_year.description: wanted first year of the interval in %Y format (e.g., '2026').

second_month.description: wanted second month of the interval in %B format (e.g., 'June').

second_year.description: wanted second year of the interval in %Y format (e.g., '2026').

function.name: get_expenses_markdown
function.description: Returns the pandas dataframe in markdown format for all times.
